entries.name: Guardian GI
entries.note: Yuri’s Revenge unit; no vanilla RA2 equivalent. Includes deployed missile stance.

entries.name: Allied Engineer
entries.note: Both factions use the same engineer SHP with owner remap; separate game identities share this source.

entries.name: Soviet Engineer
entries.note: Both factions use the same engineer SHP with owner remap; separate game identities share this source.

entries.name: Allied Gate
entries.note: The surviving vanilla RA2 mission gate. See the striped road gate at the Allied base entrance.

entries.name: Soviet Gate
entries.note: Vanilla RA2 contains no completed Soviet gate art; the Soviet variant in this game is an adaptation of the one Allied mission gate.

entries.name: Apartment Block
entries.note: Representative intact tall New York apartment block in the original map render.

entries.name: Warehouse
entries.note: Representative low industrial warehouse; RA2 has several regional warehouse SHPs.

entries.name: Corner Shop
entries.note: Representative small urban storefront at native battle scale.

entries.name: Filling Station
entries.note: The original RA2 gas-station family in city context.

entries.name: Office Block
entries.note: Representative New York office towers, including damaged states.

entries.name: Shop Row
entries.note: The game role combines RA2 storefront and small city-block SHPs.

entries.name: Ruined Block
entries.note: Original damaged and burning city-building states are visible throughout this mission panorama.

entries.name: Grain Depot
entries.note: Original farm-storage and twin-silo structures in the snow village.

entries.name: Farmhouse
entries.note: Original farmhouse family in the snow village.

entries.name: Barn
entries.note: Original barn and agricultural outbuilding family in the snow village.

entries.name: Bridge Repair Hut
entries.note: The bridge-control hut is shown beside the repaired bridge in the original mission panorama.
